newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on Refrigerator fall.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on Refrigerator fall.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed down on Wednesday partly due to overseas liquidation of Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor on concerns about its prospects in the heavily competitive domestic refrigerator market, brokers said.
The index fell 0.069 points or 0.14 percent to 48.407 points, on volume of 6.6 million shares worth $3.0 million. Of 41 B shares, 34 traded, with eight down, 13 flat and 13 up.

Brokers said that heavy overseas selling of blue chip Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor hurt market sentiment. An official report on Wednesday said 13 of China's 33 refrigerator producers lost money in the first half of 1996.
Shanghai Refrigerator traded the most, falling $0.026 or 5.82 percent to $0.420, on volume of 1.6 million shares.

"Domestic institutions supported the market barometer Shanghai Lujiazui (Finance and Trade Zone Development) after it resumed trading in the afternoon in order to allow them to help the rights issue," one broker said. "It gave the market confidence."
Shanghai Lujiazui ended up $0.010 or 1.08 percent to $0.930, on volume of 758,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui suspended trading in the morning after announcing a three-for-10 rights issue at 5.50 yuan a share.
"There is potential for further falls in the short term with overseas liquidation expected in selective stocks," a second broker said.
Shanghai Jinjiang Tower was the biggest loser on its poor results, falling $0.020 or 8.40 percent to $0.218, on volume of 55,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares closed sharply up in active trading on bullish market sentiment, but a technical correction in the near future is expected, brokers said.

The A index soared 36.964 points or 3.60 percent to 1064.609 points, on volume of 348.2 million shares worth 10.8 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 75.663 points or 2.89 percent to 2691.649 points.
Shanghai Lujiazui reached an all-time high of 48.80 yuan before closing at 47.68 yuan, up 0.82 yuan, on volume of 4.859 million shares worth 232 million yuan.
Chengdu Gongyi Metallurgy was the star on speculative buying, surging 1.50 yuan or 23.96 percent to 7.76 yuan, on volume of 17.8 million shares.
